scope: Observed-phase-point Galactic orbits, varying tidal forcing and host-support diagnostics; no remnant trajectories or tidally re-equilibrated host
distance_policy: Catalog Cartesian state is the anchor. Change heliocentric distance by adding the corresponding displacement and transverse velocity difference at the published sky coordinates/proper motion. The host_distance case uses the selected host distance. No solar constants are refitted and no independent posterior combination is claimed.
astrometric_basis: ICRS unit position and RA/Dec tangent vectors, rotated into IAU Galactic coordinates and reflected in X to match the catalog; checked independently against Astropy

integration.time_interpretation: One Gyr forward reference orbit in a fixed axisymmetric Galactic potential; not a forecast of unchanged internal cluster structure.

events: spherical radial extrema via R dot V=0

force_accuracy.bound: Exact differential acceleration bounded by radius times a componentwise analytic Hessian supremum over the spatial ball. Solve bound/cluster acceleration=epsilon.
force_accuracy.interpretation: Sufficient instantaneous isolated-control domain; conservative, not a measured edge or accumulated trajectory-error bound
force_accuracy.fixed_control_rule: Floor the refined minimum sufficient radius in pc for the host_distance case to a whole pc; conditional conservative control, not a physical edge.

opening_diagnostic: Largest eigenvalue of T+|omega|^2 I-omega omega^T, omega=R cross V/|R|^2. Solve G M(<r)/r^3=lambda. Frozen-frame scale only; Euler acceleration and time evolution preclude stationary escape interpretation.
host_response_indicator: t_dyn(r) ||dT/dt||_2 / ||T||_2 in fixed axes, t_dyn=sqrt(r^3/[G M(<r)]). Timescale comparison, not a heating rate or calibrated adiabatic correction.
uncertainty: Four conditional sensitivity cases; no posterior interval. Missing Galactic-model, solar-frame and cross-observable covariances remain unpropagated.
not_performed: replacement of the stellar distribution function
coordinate_check: Standard J2000 matrix differs from independent Astropy6.0.1 ICRS/Galactic rotation by less than 1e-7 per element, negligible compared with 0.01 kpc catalog rounding.
